sections.title: AI Services for New York Insurance Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for New York's world-leading insurance and reinsurance market.

blocks.heading: Commercial Lines and Specialty Underwriting AI
paragraphs: For AIG, AXA XL, Chubb, and New York's global commercial insurance community:

Commercial property underwriting ML: ML for commercial property risk assessment incorporating building characteristics, occupancy, protection class, and the specific geography-level risk factors (storm surge, wildfire, earthquake) that affect New York's global commercial property portfolio — which covers buildings and facilities across every geography on earth.

Specialty lines underwriting: ML for the specialty insurance lines concentrated in New York — Directors and Officers (D&O), Errors and Omissions (E&O), Cyber, and Marine insurance require ML models calibrated to the specific risk factors of each specialty line.

Claims triage and severity prediction: ML for commercial claims severity prediction and triage — identifying large loss claims early in the claims process for expedited handling and major case unit referral for AIG's and Chubb's large commercial claims operations.
Cost: $60,000–$170,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | NAIC, NYDFS

blocks.heading: Reinsurance Analytics
paragraphs: New York is the reinsurance capital of the US — Munich Re America, Swiss Re America, and dozens of reinsurance companies concentrate their US operations in New York:

Catastrophe model augmentation: ML augmenting traditional CAT models (RMS, AIR, Karen Clark) with alternative data — satellite imagery, social media damage signals, and real-time weather data — for more timely and accurate CAT loss estimation for New York's reinsurance portfolios.

Reinsurance pricing analytics: ML for reinsurance rate adequacy and pricing optimization — incorporating treaty exposure data, loss history, and market pricing signals for the reinsurance pricing committees at Munich Re and Swiss Re's New York operations.

Claims development factors: ML for loss development factor prediction in reinsurance claims reserving — improving IBNR (incurred but not reported) reserve accuracy for the long-tail liability reinsurance portfolios that New York's reinsurers hold.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks | NAIC actuarial standards

blocks.heading: Life Insurance and Annuity Analytics
paragraphs: For MetLife (New York HQ) and New York Life (New York HQ):

Life insurance underwriting ML: ML for accelerated underwriting using electronic health records, prescription data, and laboratory data to replace traditional medical underwriting for eligible applicants — enabling MetLife and New York Life to offer faster, more competitive underwriting for digital distribution.

Annuity persistency prediction: ML for annuity policyholder lapse and surrender prediction — incorporating economic conditions, interest rate environment, and individual policyholder behavior signals for asset-liability management and product pricing.

Long-term care claims prediction: ML for long-term care insurance claims frequency and severity prediction — one of the most significant pricing challenges in the insurance industry given LTC's long tail and demographic uncertainty.
Cost: $55,000–$155,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | NYDFS, NY Insurance Law

blocks.heading: InsurTech AI
paragraphs: For Lemonade (NYC HQ), Oscar Health (NYC HQ), and New York's insurtech startup community:
AI-first claims processing: ML for Lemonade's AI-driven property and casualty claims — instant claims approval for low-complexity claims from photos and natural language descriptions.

InsurTech underwriting: ML for Oscar Health's health insurance underwriting and personalization — the ACA marketplace underwriting environment where community rating constraints require actuarial accuracy within regulatory guardrails.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks | NYDFS, ACA compliance

sections.title: New York Insurance AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for New York insurance AI development.

blocks.heading: NYDFS Circular 1 (Insurance AI)
paragraphs: New York's Department of Financial Services has issued guidance on the use of external data sources and algorithms in insurance underwriting — ClickMasters designs all New York insurance AI with NYDFS circular guidance compliance.

blocks.heading: New York Insurance Law (Article 23)
paragraphs: New York's insurance anti-discrimination law applies to ML-based underwriting and pricing — ClickMasters designs New York insurance AI with fair underwriting testing and NYDFS regulatory examination readiness.

blocks.heading: NAIC actuarial standards
paragraphs: The National Association of Insurance Commissioners' actuarial standards apply to reserving and pricing models — ClickMasters designs New York insurance AI with NAIC actuarial documentation requirements.
